# Functions
```{r}
compute_wis_score <- function(df, predicted, observed, target_date) {
  df_wis <- df %>%
    rename(predicted = !!rlang::sym(predicted),
           observed = !!rlang::sym(observed),
           quantile_level = output_type_id) %>%
    dplyr::select(reference_date, location, horizon, target, target_end_date,
                  output_type, quantile_level, observed, predicted) |>
    as_forecast_quantile(
      forecast_unit = c("location", "target_end_date", "horizon", "target"),
      predicted = "predicted",
      quantile_col = "quantile_level"
    ) |>
    score() |>
    mutate(horizon = horizon + 1,
           reference_date = target_date) |>
    dplyr::select(location, target_end_date, horizon, reference_date, wis)
  return(df_wis)
}
```

# Data processing
```{r}
observed$target_end_date = as.Date(observed$target_end_date)
df = left_join(predictions, observed, by = c("location", "target", "target_end_date"))
```

# WIS calculation
```{r wis_calc}
models <- unique(df$model_id)
dates <- sort(unique(df$target_end_date))

results <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(oracle_value)) %>%
  {
    models <- unique(.$model_id)
    dates <- sort(unique(.$target_end_date))
    
    map_df(models, ~ {
      model_name <- .x
      
      map_df(dates, ~ {
        target_date <- .x
        
        df_filtered <- df %>%
          filter(model_id == model_name,
                 target_end_date == target_date,
                 !is.na(oracle_value))
        
        if (nrow(df_filtered) == 0) return(NULL)
        
        compute_wis_score(
          df = df_filtered,
          predicted = "value",
          observed = "oracle_value",
          target_date = target_date
        ) %>%
          mutate(model_id = model_name)
        
      })
    })
  }
```

```{r}
head(results)
write_csv(results, "forecast_WIS.csv")
```

# Coverage rate
```{r coverage_calc}
coverage <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(oracle_value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = output_type_id,
    values_from = value,
    names_prefix = "quantile_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    coverage_95 = as.numeric(oracle_value >= quantile_0.025 & oracle_value <= quantile_0.975)
  ) %>%
  select(model_id, location, target_end_date, horizon, target, 
         reference_date, output_type, oracle_value,
         quantile_0.025, quantile_0.975, coverage_95)

head(coverage)
#write_csv(coverage, "forecast_coverage.csv")
```

```{r coverage_summary}
coverage_summary <- coverage %>%
  group_by(model_id) %>%
  summarise(
    coverage_rate = mean(coverage_95),
    count = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

coverage_summary |> arrange(-coverage_rate)
#write_csv(coverage_summary, "forecast_coverage_summary.csv")
```
